title: Preserve the discount authorization policy (ORD-001/ORD-002) with LOOKUP role semantics
target_requirement: Deliver migrated.py with set_discount(order, pct, user_id, users) -> order and a BusinessRuleViolation exception: range check 0..100 inclusive first (E5001), then discounts strictly over 20 require the acting user's looked-up ROLE_ID to be MGR or ADMIN (E5002), where LOOKUP sees live USR_MASTER rows only so unknown and soft-deleted users have no role; success returns a new order with DISC_PCT set.
expected_behavior: Exactly 20 needs no role while 20.01 requires MGR/ADMIN; unknown or soft-deleted users cannot authorize over-20 discounts but may set 20; inactive-but-live managers still authorize (ACTIVE_FLG is not consulted); -0.01 and 100.01 raise E5001 while 100 is allowed; out-of-range reports E5001 even when the role check would also fail; legacy messages preserved; inputs never mutated.
provenance: Synthetic; authored for LegacyCRM-Bench from Meridian CRM 4.2 spec (SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md §1, §2).
security_expectations: No privilege widening: an unknown, soft-deleted, or role-less user must never authorize a discount over 20 percent; no network or subprocess imports.
failure_conditions: Treating 20 as requiring a role or 20.01 as not; letting deleted/unknown users authorize; consulting ACTIVE_FLG in the lookup; swapping E5001/E5002 precedence; mutating inputs.
